name: The Dursts' Spellbook

source.note: Our own contents for the cult's spellbook in Death House; not checked against the module.

summary: A cultist's spellbook bound in black leather, its pages ruled in a cramped, careful hand. Seven Wizard spells a Wizard can copy.
text: Black calfskin over boards, the corners worn pale. Inside, in a cramped and careful hand, the spells the Dursts' cult kept for its rites: tongues of the dead, faces that aren't yours, a little borrowed life, and darkness on request. Anyone can read the list; a Wizard can copy them into their own book.
